targetTexts.1: Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
targetTexts.2: On the heights overlooking the road, at the crossroads she takes her stand.
targetTexts.3: Beside the gates to the city, at the entrances she cries out:
targetTexts.4: “To you, O men, I call out, and my cry is to the sons of men.
targetTexts.5: O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
targetTexts.6: Listen, for I speak of noble things, and the opening of my lips will reveal right.
targetTexts.7: For my mouth will speak the truth, and wickedness is detestable to my lips.
targetTexts.8: All the words of my mouth are righteous; none are crooked or perverse.
targetTexts.9: They are all plain to the discerning, and upright to those who find knowledge.
targetTexts.10: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
targetTexts.11: For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.
targetTexts.12: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
targetTexts.13: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
targetTexts.14: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight and strength.
targetTexts.15: By me kings reign, and rulers enact just laws;
targetTexts.16: By me princes rule, and all nobles who govern justly.
targetTexts.17: I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.
targetTexts.18: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.
targetTexts.19: My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.
targetTexts.20: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
targetTexts.21: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
targetTexts.22: The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.
targetTexts.23: From everlasting I was established, from the beginning, before the earth began.
targetTexts.24: When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when no springs were overflowing with water.
targetTexts.25: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,
targetTexts.26: before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
targetTexts.27: I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
targetTexts.28: when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth,
targetTexts.29: when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
targetTexts.30: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day, rejoicing always in His presence.
targetTexts.31: I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.
targetTexts.32: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
targetTexts.33: Listen to instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.
targetTexts.34: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
targetTexts.35: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD.
targetTexts.36: But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”
